outputs.explanation: Panel A is a 3D segmented/schematic rendering of pre-conoidal rings and actin filament (from cryo-electron tomography), not a plot of averaged data.
Panel B is a 3D segmented rendering of cytoplasmic actin bundles and pellicular actin, a schematic/model rather than a quantitative plot.
Inset 'a' within the central cartoon is a schematic showing position of volume A within the cell, not a data plot.
Inset 'b' within the central cartoon is a schematic showing position of volume B within the cell, not a data plot.
Inset 'c' within the central cartoon is a schematic showing position of volume C/E within the cell, not a data plot.
Panel C is a grayscale slice through a cryo-electron tomogram (micrograph) with highlighted filaments, not an averaged data plot.
Panel D is a 3D schematic/model rendering of the lateral section showing various actin populations, not a quantitative plot.
Panel E is a slice through an averaged cryo-ET density volume (image), not a plot of averaged numeric data requiring individual points.
Panel F is a grayscale tomogram slice (micrograph) showing a filament connected to a TPF, not a data plot.
